newsitem.title: USA: Walbro sees auto strike cutting Q2 profit.
newsitem.headline: Walbro sees auto strike cutting Q2 profit.

text.p: Walbro Corp said Wednesday a recent strike by workers at a Chrysler Corp engine plant was expected to cut the company's second-quarter net income by $1 million, or $0.11 a share.
Before the announcement, analysts in a First Call survey were estimating that Walbro would earn $0.31 a share in the second period, versus $0.56 in the same quarter a year ago.
The strike will also result in a second-quarter sales reduction of about $3.6 million, said Walbro, which makes fuel systems and other products for the automotive and small-engine market.
Work stoppages at General Motors Corp are not expected to affect Walbro's second quarter results, it said.
